title: El Inventario
techniques: cast silhouettes with userSpaceOnUse shadow fade
statement: I built the picture around a single decision: the glass of water is the brightest thing in the room and the mango is second. The light is a pocket low on the wall through a shutter, so the three standing objects are silhouettes separated by their edges, and their shadows fall on the lit wall — which is what makes them sit in a room and not on a shelf. The counter's front edge and the dark under it hold the register line: everything above it is the household, everything below it is the rest of the house.
